name: 별열쇠 보관소
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: Close symmetrical shot of star-shaped keys resting under individual glass domes atop a row of wooden storage cabinets. Cool teal light glows faintly from within each dome, outlining the keys' intricate edges, while warm amber cabinet lamps illuminate the polished wood below. Open lower-central foreground before the cabinet row, richly detailed craftsmanship, quiet reverent atmosphere, no people, no text, no UI.
